21:50 Local Time, 20:50 GMT, 02:20 IST: 13 wins in a row for England against Sri Lanka now in this format. A no-contest this. The target was massive and Sri Lanka struggled in the powerplay and except for a good cameo from Wellalage with the bat, no-one else contributed. Sonny Baker set the tone with a fast and fiery spell in front of his home crowd and the others chipped in. The asking rate kept going out of hand with each passing wicket and Sri Lanka were never in the races tonight. A winning start for Kevin Pietersen who's in the England white-ball setup - he signs some autographs for the crowd. Stay tuned for the post-match stuff....

Charith Asalanka | Sri Lanka Captain: [On whether he would make the same decision to bowl first if he won the toss again] Yes, I think I would have done the same thing. But, you know, it's a tough day out here for us because credit goes to, first of all, Harry Brook and Jos Buttler for their exceptional innings, and at the same time, I think we missed our plans and execution. [On finding positives from the defeat to take into the next match in Cardiff] From my perspective, positive-wise, didn't happen anything for me. But, you know, especially when we are playing with these guys, they have been playing really good cricket, I mean recently, so all three departments must be spot on. [On whether the high-scoring conditions at the Utility Bowl played as expected] Actually, I didn't think about that high, but of course we know that it's always high-scoring venues in England.
Sri Lanka need to regroup and quickly as the series moves to Cardiff next. We will be there to bring you all the action from that game. Do join us then. For now, that's it. It's bye bye.
